reviews.title: Disappointing and Frustrating User Experience
reviews.text:
I purchased the $100 Premium subscription specifically to track my shots and learn my club distances using my Apple Watch. Unfortunately, the interface is confusing and unintuitive, and basic functions like selecting a club are unnecessarily difficult to find and configure. Worse, I can’t properly test or learn the shot-tracking features unless I’m physically at the golf course. I shouldn’t have to troubleshoot an app while trying to play golf. So far, I’ve essentially paid $100 for GPS yardages, which I already had through another app. Very disappointing.

This is the second time I’m submitting this review because 18birdies deleted my review to make their stats look better

reviews.title: New update issue
reviews.text: I have thousands of swings recorded using the ai swing analyzer. After the update in September to the analyzer (which was needed) the camera no longer works in the app. When I set up the camera looks great but as soon as I hit record the screen goes dark and it doesn’t detect anything. Asked for help and got no help. Can’t recommend this anymore unless an update comes out.

reviews.title: Great App, Woeful support
reviews.text: Over 12 months I have submitted a scorecard for my home course as the App has incorrect Par & Handicap information for various holes/tees. It takes between 2 and 6 months for support to reply and even then there is no resolution and sometimes a question along the lines of ‘what am I asking?’. I suspect there are underlying problems at this business, which is a shame.

reviews.title: Make their money hoping you forget to cancel
reviews.text:
Downloaded the trial for a couple of weeks to test the app. Not for me, but without warning or a reminder get charged £99.99 for a year’s subscription. This is exactly what the UK government will be stopping soon. 

Poor behaviour. Any decent company would remind you first.

reviews.title: Wasn’t updated

reviews.title: Glitchy and not good with Apple Watch.
reviews.text: I took the 7-day free trial of all the premium features inc smart tracking, but it doesn’t work well with Apple Watch. There’s no facility on the watch to tell it what club you’re using. It does seem to track the shots somehow but without the club info there doesn’t seem much point. After I completed my round it asked me to go back over every hole and confirm what club I used for each shot. How am I supposed to remember? It should ask at the time of taking the shot. Also after the round when I was trying to review my scores the app was very glitchy and kept causing my phone to crash. Subscription cancelled, I’m sorry to say.

reviews.title: No response from Customer Support
reviews.text:
The 18Birdies app is good, but I am very disappointed by the lack of response from customer support and social media channels.

My home course does not have the correct hole order in the app, whilst competitor apps appear to have this set up correctly. I have sent four emails and two Facebook messages with all the details required, but I have received no response.

This is particularly disappointing because I have been seriously considering moving to Premium, however I cannot justify paying for a subscription when I cannot get support for what appears to be a relatively straightforward issue.

reviews.title: No response from support
reviews.text: We’re really keen to get our course mapped (Tabori Golf Club), but support haven’t replied to our request for almost a month. It’s a shame, as the app looks great

reviews.title: Overpriced for the quality of service
reviews.text:
The app used to be quite good to use on watch while playing. But it now absolutely kills the battery since updates. 

I have emailed the devs multiple times regarding adding the other tees and course ratings for my home course but never received a response and it has not been updated.

Cancelled my subscription because £105 for almost no benefits is not worth while.
